note: Golden examples for the Style Guide (docs/STYLE.md, 'Golden examples'). The owner chose style N (dusk robe) on 2026-10-23, so the wizard files are N's. The enemy, tiles and effects are still the earlier placeholders: they are redrawn in the chosen style one area at a time (M2 design, 'Art and the art direction'), and each is replaced here when it is. The starter kit zip includes these files next to the palette and templates.

examples.shows: The player character body: a narrow dusk (Stone) robe with a Spark placket, belt and hem, two big tall eyes and no mouth, Wood staff, no player colour, feet about 2-3 px above the bottom edge
The player's hat, its own layer drawn over the body: the big pointed hat with a Spark band in the player's ramp (Player 1 here), the only part with a player colour
The blink layer: closed eyes in Skin with a black line, drawn over the body's eyes for a moment every few seconds
An enemy: Fire body, Bone horns and Spark eyes, no player colour, a bold silhouette
A raised tile: lit top and left edge, shaded bottom and right edge
A flat tile: Stone base, a few inner details, nothing on the outer edge so it repeats
A projectile: a streak in Bone materials with a Spark core, outlined in its own shadow shade
An impact: a flat burst in Spark materials, over in 0.2 s
